summary: The three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis does not bound the grouped rank-two anisotropy ratio R=||Pn||^2/Delta. The explicit five-coordinate target-valid family has Delta=epsilon, ||Pn||=epsilon^-1, overlap currency V=Delta^2||Pn||^2=1, R=epsilon^-3 -> infinity, and exactly three eigenvalues of modulus at least one for 0<epsilon<1. This refutes only the shortcut of bounding R spectrally; it does not refute QFORM. The same run proves a p>2 adaptive kernel-derivative family reducing the previous power loss to a logarithmic loss.
